osphranter-rufus.title: Kangaroo
osphranter-rufus.author: Stephengury
osphranter-rufus.surfaceType: credited artist image textures; not a living scan
osphranter-rufus.websiteRig: Original bound skeleton and source-shape derivative; finite illustrative studies, not measured biomechanics
osphranter-rufus.changes: Nine original image payloads and source UVs retained. Specular-glossiness diffuse materials are converted to core dielectric PBR; source colors and dark eyes are preserved. The website normalizes source axes/body proportions, shortens the posterior tail modestly, and binds one 27-joint surface to tail-assisted slow travel, paired hopping, search and repose.
osphranter-rufus.biology: Artist reconstruction; identity, anatomy, skin optics and motion require specialist review. Molecular records are independent of this model.
